relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: intra-PBN injecting of CGRP induced an obvious anti-nociceptive effect in naive and neuropathic pain rats in a dose-dependent manner

relationships.subject: CGRP 8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: the CGRP-induced antinociception was significantly reduced after injection of CGRP 8-37

relationships.subject: neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Neuropathic pain induced decreases in the expression of CGRP receptor, as well as in CGRP-induced antinociception in PBN.

key_findings: Intra-PBN CGRP is antinociceptive in naive and neuropathic rats via CGRP receptor (CLR); neuropathic pain reduces PBN CLR expression and CGRP antinociception.
